plugin.name: Bluetooth
plugin.description: Quick connect/disconnect paired Bluetooth devices without leaving the game
plugin.subtitle: Pair devices without leaving the game

agent.summary: Connect and disconnect paired Bluetooth devices, toggle the adapter, and scan for new ones — without leaving the game. Talks to BlueZ over D-Bus.

getDevices.description: Every known device with its MAC, name, type and current connected/paired state. Start here — the MAC addresses the other methods take come from this.

getAdapterInfo.description: Adapter power state, name, address and whether a scan is running. If `powered` is false, connecting will fail until togglePower(true).

connectDevice.description: Connect to an already-paired device by MAC address.
connectDevice.notes: Pairing is not done here — the device must already be paired. Can take several seconds while the link comes up.

disconnectDevice.description: Disconnect a connected device by MAC address.
disconnectDevice.notes: If this is the headset the user is listening through, audio moves back to the speakers immediately.

togglePower.description: Power the Bluetooth adapter on or off.
togglePower.notes: Powering off drops every connected device, including controllers.

startScan.description: Begin discovery. Non-blocking — poll getDevices to see what turns up, then stopScan when done.
startScan.notes: Holds a long-lived discovery session open; it drains battery until stopped.

stopScan.description: End the discovery session started by startScan.
